prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production fantasy videogame terrain texture atlas for Dragons and Dungeons, EXACTLY 6 columns by 6 rows of 36 equally sized square cells. Orthographic strictly top-down overhead ground material, no perspective, no sky, no characters, no buildings, no text, no borders. Each cell is a richly illustrated game ground texture suitable for a 3D board with game objects added later. Seamless gentle ground edges, avoid huge landmarks. Row 1 six different medieval village countryside surfaces: mossy flagstone road, trampled grass with amber leaves, cobblestone plaza, garden soil, pale limestone slabs, riverside pebbles. Row 2 six forest ground variants: emerald grass, fern undergrowth, oak leaf litter, wet roots and moss, bluebell flowers, earthy forest path. Row3 six ancient abbey ruins ground variants: fractured marble, cracked limestone, mossy stone floor, fallen dust and gravel, faded mosaic, pale ash ground. Row4 six crypt ground variants: worn grey stone slabs, dark blue stone, damp gravel, violet-tinted ritual tile, fractured black flagstone, aged dusty limestone. Row5 six canyon ground variants: red ochre sandstone, dry cracked earth, granite gravel, amber sand, basalt gravel, scorched path. Row6 six dragon lair ground variants: obsidian rock, cooled lava, glowing tiny lava cracks, dark basalt, scattered gold flecks on stone, ash dust. Premium high detail 3D game materials, physically lit with soft neutral ambient light, consistent scale and subtle shading across all 36 cells. Full bleed square atlas, opaque background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production game character token atlas. Perfectly regular 6 columns by 6 rows grid, exactly 36 separate equally sized cells with transparent background and generous empty margins in each cell. No borders or labels or text. Every cell has one detailed full-body fantasy miniature seen from above at 45 degrees, centered on a dark bronze circular miniature base, whole character and base inside cell. Premium sculpted videogame 3D miniatures with rich material detail, same scale, lighting and camera for all, upper-left soft key light. Palette midnight teal, ancient bronze, jade, amber, arcane cyan. Row1: human armored male knight, human armored female knight, elven male ranger, elven female ranger, human male wizard, human female wizard. Row2: dwarf male fighter, dwarf female fighter, tiefling male warlock, tiefling female warlock, orc male barbarian, orc female barbarian. Row3: human male cleric, human female cleric, gnome male bard, gnome female bard, halfling male rogue, halfling female rogue. Row4: dragonborn paladin, human monk, elf druid, human merchant, elderly village elder, town guard. Row5: goblin warrior, wolf, skeleton warrior, zombie, bandit archer, cultist mage. Row6: ogre, giant spider, brown bear, troll, red dragon wyrmling, red adult dragon compact coiled pose. All original fantasy designs, readable distinctive silhouettes, no branded characters. True transparent background.

Use case: logo-brand. Create an exclusive polished fantasy roleplaying videogame logo with EXACT text 'DRAGONS' on first line, a tiny 'AND' on center second line, 'DUNGEONS' on third line. A bronze dragon curves in a circle surrounding a faceted d20 gemstone above the text. Premium carved weathered metallic bronze and golden serif letters, restrained magical cyan in the gemstone, elegant sharp readable typography. Symmetrical compact composition, high detail physically rendered 3D metal, subtle highlights, designed to sit on dark teal game menu. Entire mark isolated on true transparent background with generous margin, no extra words, no watermark.
